# Bundled libraries

These files are unmodified copies of open-source libraries, bundled so JustApply works offline.

| File | Library | License |
|---|---|---|
| `papaparse.min.js` | Papa Parse 5.4.1, https://github.com/mholt/PapaParse | MIT |
| `d3.min.js` | D3 7.9.0, https://github.com/d3/d3 | ISC |
| `d3-sankey.min.js` | d3-sankey 0.12.3, https://github.com/d3/d3-sankey | BSD-3-Clause |
| `Geist-Variable.woff2` | Geist font 1.3.1 by Vercel, https://github.com/vercel/geist-font | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

Each file keeps its original copyright header.
